Confirmed — `assertWithinLimit` and `changePlan` in `src/server/services/billing-service.ts` throw plain `Error` objects (lines 117, 138, 169), which `toAppError()` cannot recognize, so they resolve to `internal_error` rather than the `plan_limit_exceeded` the requirements doc promises.

I've independently verified all four discrepancy categories against the actual source:

1. **Plan quota** — `docs/requirements/billing-and-plan-limits.md` (REQ-134) states the free plan allows 3 projects; `src/config/plan-limits.ts` actually sets `free.projects = 2`.
2. **Rollout percentage** — `docs/requirements/feature-flags.md` (REQ-189) claims the `ai_issue_summary` rollout hashes only the organization id so all members of an org see the same state; `src/lib/feature-flags.ts`'s `bucketOf()` hashes `flag:orgId:userId`, so members of the same org can land in different buckets.
3. **Throttle bucket** — `docs/ops/notes-2026-01-30-rate-limiter-sizing.md` states `auth:password-reset` is "charged per identity (email address), not per organization"; the code (`src/actions/auth/reset-password.ts`, `src/server/services/auth-service.ts`) always keys that bucket with a single fixed constant (`ANONYMOUS_ORG_ID`/`ANONYMOUS_ORG`), so it's actually one shared global bucket, never per-identity.
4. **Error codes** — `docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md` (DES-222) and `docs/api/actions-overview.md` both assert that the six action-layer error classes (`ForbiddenActionError`, `PlanLimitError`, `RateLimitedError`, `FeatureUnavailableError`, `ActionNotFoundError`, `UnauthorizedActionError`) are translated by `toAppError()` into their specific codes; `src/lib/errors.ts`'s `toAppError()` has no `instanceof` branch for any of them, so every one collapses to generic `internal_error` (500). `docs/requirements/billing-and-plan-limits.md` (REQ-138, REQ-141) makes the same false claim specifically for plan-limit failures, which actually throw plain `Error`s in `billing-service.ts`.

ANSWER: docs/requirements/billing-and-plan-limits.md, docs/requirements/feature-flags.md, docs/ops/notes-2026-01-30-rate-limiter-sizing.md, docs/design/action-wrapper-and-errors.md, docs/api/actions-overview.md
